### Added

- *(agent-platform)* Workspace detail page with Sync now and its Sessions in [#3184](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3184) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(agent-platform)* One provider connect prompt for every provider instance in [#3185](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3185) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(muster)* Split a connector tool's page into Overview, Run it and Usage tabs in [#3198](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3198) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(muster)* Link Usage → Connectors rows to each connector's Usage tab in [#3197](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3197) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(agent-platform)* Say when an agent's toolset is bound to each session in [#3193](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3193) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)

### Fixed

- *(agent-platform,gs-node)* Read every page of muster's list_tools; tenant servers' tools on their tile in [#3194](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3194) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)
- *(gs-node)* Reuse a person's pending muster sign-in, not one per poll in [#3195](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3195) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(agent-platform)* An Organization's agent runs on the platform Harness and is created in its tenant in [#3196](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3196) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.16.2...v3.17.0
